simulationControl.persistence: Test state is shared for this runtime only. A new runtime starts safety unsafe.

camera.description:
Optional camera capabilities, readings and timing for explicit tests.
Ordinary geometry/settings still use the common camera command path.

coverCalibrator.description:
Sparse independent cover/light state. Component state updates replace
only that component's pending operation; durations do not stop either.

fault.description: Failure to inject. "none" clears a fault; omitted leaves it unchanged.

filterWheel.description:
Sparse wheel state. Metadata or Position replaces a pending movement;
duration and fault changes do not stop it. Arrays must remain aligned.

focuser.description:
Sparse focuser test state. Injecting position/motion/limits replaces a
pending simulated movement; other fields do not stop it.

rotator.description:
Sparse rotator test state; coordinate/motion/reversal fields replace a
pending movement. Other controls do not stop it.

safe.description: Simulated raw safety reading. Starts false on each new runtime.

sampleAgeSeconds.description:
Fixed age reported for each new simulated scalar observation. Refresh
represents a fresh sensor acquisition and resets this to zero.

switchValues.description:
Inject channel readings, including read-only sensors. Ordinary switch
commands still enforce write permissions and the same value grid.

weather.description: Update weather readings; null removes a simulated sensor.

simulationControl.uncertainWrites: Changing a fault does not clear an uncertain-write latch. Disconnect every source lease before retrying commands.

validation: The hub validates relationships, identities, capabilities and revisions before applying. Schema validation alone does not authorize an update.
